title: Chapter 37 Hope At Dawn
content:
Chapter 37 Hope At Dawn

Even if there was a person who could defeat the bronze boss, there was no way to use two buckets to fight against the heavy rain.

Wang Shuo gave up after holding on for less than 5 minutes.

Wang Shuo had to build another wall under the eaves. This could effectively resist the speed of the flood flooding into the houses.

Finally, at 12 o'clock in the evening, there was already a vast ocean outside the house.

Seeing his house soaked in water, Wang Shuo was also a little anxious. This was his property and could not be destroyed like this!

"Use the water-proof sky curtain."

A huge light curtain was immediately propped up, like a pot cover, and the water in the light curtain was automatically discharged.

Moreover, the size of the light curtain can be adjusted within a certain range.

Wang Shuo adjusted the light curtain to cover the entire wall, and the heavy rain in the sky had nothing to do with him.

It was quite magical.

Wang Shuo put 24 energy crystals into the water-proof sky curtain and held on for 1 day.

At this time, the current number of survivors began to decrease at a speed visible to the naked eye.

2571/10000, 2556/10000.

The numbers kept decreasing, and Wang Shuo felt scared.

The intensity of this flood far exceeded the expectations of some players.

Those players who were not well prepared or unable to prepare began to be eliminated at a very fast speed.

When Wang Shuo came outside the house the next morning, he saw that the entire light curtain was flooded, and the entire light curtain was already under the water.

Not knowing whether the heavy rain was still falling, Wang Shuo got some food, and the number of people had dropped to 1500. Nearly 2000 people were eliminated overnight.

Open the [Chat Channel].

"How are you all?"

"I can't hold on, Gulu, Gulu!"

"Help, help!"

This was a crying voice, and it was a girl.

Wang Shuo took another bite of the pancake he made, and could only remain silent.

In the [chat channel], only a few people occasionally said a few words, most people were silent, and more people had no chance to speak again.

In the face of absolute natural disasters, players seemed particularly helpless. Even those players who built big ships fell!

Floods cannot guarantee that the ship will not capsize or sink.

At this moment, Wang Shuo noticed that the light curtain countdown was only 16 hours.

"I hope the flood will recede today!"

He opened the [side quest] again.

The "Hope at Dawn" quest actually had a countdown.

At this time, there were still 22 hours before the end of the quest, which means it will end at 8 o'clock tomorrow morning.

And Wang Shuo's water-proof sky-shading curtain can only last until 12 o'clock tonight, which is still 8 hours away.

I don't know if I need to invest energy crystals in the water-proof sky-shading curtain.

Based on the principle of saving as much as possible.

He hurried to the yard and planned to build a high platform so that he could stand on it.

But when he opened his backpack, he found that there was not a single fire brick left.

In desperation, he could only use wood to make a huge raft.

In the evening, Wang Shuo learned from the [Chat Channel] that the rain had stopped.

This rain lasted for 24 hours.

The rest of the time was to wait for the flood to recede.

Until 12 o'clock in the night, the height of the flood still exceeded the top of the water-proof canopy, and Wang Shuo had to invest 8 energy crystals again.

Wang Shuo did not sleep all night yesterday. At this time, he finally couldn't hold on any longer. He planned to sleep for a while and get up to see the situation around 5 o'clock.

That night, Wang Shuo had two dreams.

In the first dream, he dreamed that he was wearing a yellow robe and he could get a hundred responses. Gradually, he lost himself in the cheers of countless people.

In the second dream, he dreamed that he became a tool man, digging in the dark mine day and night. Every day was such a monotonous and boring day, and then he died of old age!

Suddenly woke up, the time was exactly 5:30, and the flood had receded to the height of the wall.

He didn't know where all the floods went, just like he didn't know how such a big flood suddenly appeared.

He could only attribute everything to the masterpiece of Lord Zach.

Wang Shuo checked his friends and found that Chef Zhang, Duan Wenxi, Zhao Shanhe and others were still alive. He didn't know how they avoided the flood.

Two hours passed quickly.

At 8 o'clock in the morning on the 14th day, Lord Zach's voice rang in the minds of every surviving player.

[Congratulations to all players for successfully completing the "Hope at Dawn" mission. ]

The voice that every player disliked the most before was like a heavenly sound at this time. He announced that every player could live for a while longer.

Who would want to die if they could survive!

[There are still 1,357 surviving players now, which is more than expected. The strength of your players is still very good. ]

[The current ranking is now announced. ]

10th place: Ye Tianba.

9th place: Zhang Yang.

8th place: Liu Dahai.

7th place: Yue Ji.

6th place: Zhao Shanhe.

Fifth place: Wu Han.

Fourth place: Zhao Tianze.

Third place: Zeta.

Second place: Su Xiu.

First place: Wang Shuo.

Ye Tianba: "Hahaha, I said I would definitely survive. In the next world, there will be a place for me, Ye Tianba."

Zhao Tianze: "I am the son of destiny. How could I be ranked fourth? What kind of shit luck did Wang Shuo have?"

"Oh my God, I have already upgraded the stone house. How could I not be on the list? Impossible! There must be an inside story."

"I have 8,000 gold coins. How could I lose to them? Lord Zach, are you mistaken?"

"I don't accept it. My IQ is 179. How could I not be on the list!"

Yue Ji: "I was scared to death. Fortunately, I was on the list."

...

At this time, the [Chat Channel] was in chaos, and the players' speeches were swiping the screen at a very fast speed.

Lord Zach did not pay attention to the complaints of these players.

[Now start the elimination round. After 8 days, or when the number of people drops to 100, we will start the "Village Building Order" competition. 】

After Lord Zach announced the rules, the [Chat Channel] fell into a strange silence.

Every player realized that everyone else had become his competitor.

They were really enemies all over the world!

Many active players had already started to contact their friends privately, wanting to form an alliance. After all, there were 100 places available, and as long as they could develop together, it was not impossible to enter the top 100.

Players on the list were the first choice for alliance.

Some players also started to form cliques directly in the chat channel.

It was nothing more than grouping together for warmth, resource sharing, and common development.

Some players on the list also began to publicly recruit younger brothers.

At this time, Wang Shuo's friends' private messages and new friends added started to increase by 99+ again.

He was temporarily ranked first at this time, and naturally he had the most people to curry favor with.

Wang Shuo wanted to think about the alliance carefully, but in the flood outside the wall, a floating wooden stake attracted his attention.
